gloss: fault; slip; oversight; one's own fault

definitions.explanation: A mistake or failing for which someone is to blame, especially a lapse in care or duty. Used mostly when asking whose fault something was.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{落|お}ち{度|ど}です。

examples.english: He is not at fault in any way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{落|お}ち{度|ど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きかった→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: In this accident, the company was largely to blame.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {落|お}ち{度|ど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ / ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to be / not be at fault
- ⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{落|お}ち{度|ど}: our fault (common in business apologies)
- {落|お}ち{度|ど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to admit one's fault
- {落|お}ち{度|ど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{責|せ}める→責める：02284_semeru⟧: to blame someone for a slip

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧: an everyday word for a mistake; says nothing about blame
- ⟦{過失|かしつ}→過失：00194_kashitsu⟧: negligence; the legal and formal term
- {落|お}ち{度|ど}: who is to blame for a lapse; common in apologies and disputes
